<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Harwill — Finished Goods Inventory</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --bg:        #080b10;
  --surface:   #0e1219;
  --surface2:  #141a24;
  --surface3:  #1a2231;
  --border:    #1c2535;
  --border2:   #243040;
  --accent:    #00dba8;
  --accent2:   #3b9eff;
  --accent-dim: rgba(0,219,168,0.10);
  --accent2-dim: rgba(59,158,255,0.10);
  --text:      #e2e8f4;
  --text2:     #6e84a0;
  --text3:     #3d5268;
  --active:    #00dba8;
  --hold:      #f5a623;
  --inactive:  #3d5268;
  --qa:        #a78bfa;
  --rtv:       #fb7185;
  --row-even:  rgba(20,26,36,0.4);
  --row-hover: rgba(0,219,168,0.05);
  --shadow:    0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}

html { font-size: 14px; }
body {
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 400;
  min-height: 100vh;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ── TOP GLOW ── */
body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--accent) 40%, var(--accent2) 60%, transparent 100%);
  z-index: 9999;
}

/* ── HEADER ── */
header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 0 36px;
  height: 60px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 200;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
}
.logo {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--text);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.logo-dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent);
}
.header-right {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
}
.header-chip {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,219,168,0.2);
}
.header-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-weight: 300;
}

/* ── KPI BAR ── */
.kpi-bar {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
}
.kpi {
  padding: 20px 28px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.kpi:last-child { border-right: none; }
.kpi::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 28px; right: 28px; height: 2px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
.kpi.accent::after { background: var(--accent); opacity: 1; }
.kpi.blue::after   { background: var(--accent2); opacity: 1; }
.kpi-label {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text3);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.kpi-value {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  color: var(--text);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}
.kpi.accent .kpi-value { color: var(--accent); }
.kpi.blue   .kpi-value { color: var(--accent2); }
.kpi-sub {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text3);
  margin-top: 5px;
  font-weight: 300;
}

/* ── FILTER BAR ── */
.filter-bar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 14px 24px;
  background: var(--surface2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.filter-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.filter-label {
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text3);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* Custom select wrapper */
.select-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.select-wrap::after {
  content: "\25BE";
  position: absolute;
  right: 10px;
  color: var(--text3);
  pointer-events: none;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
}
.flt-select {
  appearance: none;
  background: var(--surface3);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text2);
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 400;
  padding: 7px 28px 7px 12px;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  min-width: 140px;
}
.flt-select:hover  { border-color: var(--border2); color: var(--text); }
.flt-select:focus  { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); }
.flt-select.active { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-dim); }

/* Search input */
.search-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex: 1;
  max-width: 320px;
  min-width: 180px;
}
.search-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 11px;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.search-input {
  width: 100%;
  background: var(--surface3);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: var(--text);
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  padding: 7px 12px 7px 30px;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}
.search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text3); }
.search-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }

.filter-divider {
  width: 1px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--border2);
  margin: 0 4px;
}

.reset-btn {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text3);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  transition: color 0.15s, background 0.15s;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
}
.reset-btn:hover { color: var(--rtv); background: rgba(251,113,133,0.08); }

/* active filter chips */
.active-filters {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 0 24px 10px;
  background: var(--surface2);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.active-filters:empty { display: none; }
.filter-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 3px 9px 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  background: var(--accent-dim);
  color: var(--accent);
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,219,168,0.2);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.filter-chip:hover { background: rgba(0,219,168,0.18); }
.filter-chip .chip-x { opacity: 0.6; font-size: 0.65rem; }

/* ── TOOLBAR ── */
.toolbar {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 24px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: 12px;
}
.result-count {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--text2);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.result-count strong { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.sort-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}

/* ── TABLE ── */
.table-wrap {
  overflow: auto;
  flex: 1;
}
.table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar { height: 5px; width: 5px; }
.table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--surface); }
.table-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border2); border-radius: 3px; }

.content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: calc(100vh - 60px - 89px - 49px - 42px); }

table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
thead { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; }
th {
  background: var(--surface2);
  color: var(--text3);
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 11px 16px;
  text-align: left;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border2);
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  transition: color 0.15s;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
}
th:hover { color: var(--text2); }
th.sorted { color: var(--accent); }
th .sa { margin-left: 4px; opacity: 0.4; font-size: 0.55rem; }
th.sorted .sa { opacity: 1; }

tbody tr {
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,37,53,0.8);
  transition: background 0.1s;
  cursor: pointer;
}
tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: var(--row-even); }
tbody tr:hover { background: var(--row-hover); }

td {
  padding: 11px 16px;
  color: var(--text2);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  max-width: 200px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
td.sku  { color: var(--accent2); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.78rem; }
td.lot  { color: var(--text); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; }
td.desc { color: var(--text); max-width: 280px; font-weight: 400; }
td.num  { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-align: right; color: var(--text); }
td.thc  { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-align: right; color: var(--accent); }
td.cbd  { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-align: right; color: var(--accent2); }
td.dim  { color: var(--text3); font-size: 0.72rem; }

/* badges */
.badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 3px 9px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
}
.badge::before { content: ''; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; }
.badge-active   { background: rgba(0,219,168,0.10); color: var(--active);   border: 1px solid rgba(0,219,168,0.2);  }
.badge-active::before   { background: var(--active); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--active); }
.badge-inactive { background: rgba(61,82,104,0.15); color: #4e6880;         border: 1px solid rgba(61,82,104,0.25); }
.badge-inactive::before { background: var(--inactive); }
.badge-hold     { background: rgba(245,166,35,0.10); color: var(--hold);    border: 1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.2);  }
.badge-hold::before     { background: var(--hold); }
.badge-qa       { background: rgba(167,139,250,0.10); color: var(--qa);     border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
.badge-qa::before       { background: var(--qa); }
.badge-rtv      { background: rgba(251,113,133,0.10); color: var(--rtv);    border: 1px solid rgba(251,113,133,0.2); }
.badge-rtv::before      { background: var(--rtv); }

.prov-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: var(--accent2-dim);
  color: var(--accent2);
  border: 1px solid rgba(59,158,255,0.18);
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

/* ── PAGINATION ── */
.pagination {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 10px 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.page-info { color: var(--text3); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.page-btns { display: flex; gap: 3px; align-items: center; }
.page-btn {
  background: var(--surface2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--text2);
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 4px 11px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  min-width: 32px;
  text-align: center;
}
.page-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-dim); }
.page-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.25; cursor: not-allowed; }
.page-btn.current { background: var(--accent-dim); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
.page-size-select {
  appearance: none;
  background: var(--surface2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--text3);
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  outline: none;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ── EMPTY ── */
.empty-state {
  padding: 80px 24px;
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text3);
}
.empty-icon { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 14px; opacity: 0.3; }
.empty-state p { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 300; }

/* ── MODAL ── */
.modal-backdrop {
  display: none;
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  z-index: 300;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.modal-backdrop.open { display: flex; }
.modal {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: 16px;
  width: 640px;
  max-width: 95vw;
  max-height: 88vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  box-shadow: 0 40px 100px rgba(0,0,0,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,219,168,0.06);
  animation: modalIn 0.2s ease;
}
@keyframes modalIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.98); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}
.modal-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px 28px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  gap: 16px;
}
.modal-sku { font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent2); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.modal-title {
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text);
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.modal-close {
  background: var(--surface2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  color: var(--text3);
  width: 30px; height: 30px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  transition: all 0.15s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.modal-close:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--text3); }
.modal-body { padding: 24px 28px; }
.detail-section { margin-bottom: 24px; }
.detail-section-title {
  font-size: 0.58rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text3);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.detail-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 14px 20px;
}
.detail-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; }
.detail-item.full { grid-column: 1/-1; }
.detail-key { font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text3); }
.detail-val { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text); font-weight: 400; word-break: break-word; }
.detail-val.mono { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="logo">
    <div class="logo-dot"></div>
    Harwill Finished Goods
  </div>
  <div class="header-right">
    <span class="header-chip">FG Count Active</span>
    <span class="header-date" id="todayDate"></span>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="kpi-bar">
  <div class="kpi accent">
    <div class="kpi-label">Records Shown</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" id="statFiltered">—</div>
    <div class="kpi-sub">of <span id="statTotal">—</span> total</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi blue">
    <div class="kpi-label">Total Units</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" id="statUnits">—</div>
    <div class="kpi-sub">in filtered view</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi accent">
    <div class="kpi-label">Active Lines</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" id="statActive">—</div>
    <div class="kpi-sub">in current view</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi">
    <div class="kpi-label">Provinces</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" id="statProvinces">—</div>
    <div class="kpi-sub">in view</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi">
    <div class="kpi-label">Product Types</div>
    <div class="kpi-value" id="statTypes">—</div>
    <div class="kpi-sub">in view</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- FILTER BAR -->
<div class="filter-bar">
  <div class="search-wrap">
    <span class="search-icon">⌕</span>
    <input class="search-input" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search description, lot, SKU…" oninput="onSearch(this.value)">
  </div>

  <div class="filter-divider"></div>

  <div class="filter-group">
    <span class="filter-label">Province</span>
    <div class="select-wrap">
      <select class="flt-select" id="selProvince" onchange="onDropdown('province', this)">
        <option value="">All Provinces</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-group">
    <span class="filter-label">Type</span>
    <div class="select-wrap">
      <select class="flt-select" id="selType" onchange="onDropdown('type', this)">
        <option value="">All Types</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-group">
    <span class="filter-label">Status</span>
    <div class="select-wrap">
      <select class="flt-select" id="selStatus" onchange="onDropdown('status', this)">
        <option value="">All Statuses</option>
        <option value="Active">Active</option>
        <option value="Hold">Hold</option>
        <option value="QA">QA</option>
        <option value="RTV">RTV</option>
        <option value="Inactive">Inactive</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-group">
    <span class="filter-label">SKU</span>
    <div class="select-wrap">
      <select class="flt-select" id="selSKU" onchange="onDropdown('sku', this)">
        <option value="">All SKUs</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-group">
    <span class="filter-label">Lot</span>
    <input class="search-input" id="lotInput" placeholder="Lot number…" oninput="onLotInput(this.value)" style="min-width:130px;max-width:160px;">
  </div>

  <button class="reset-btn" onclick="resetAll()">↺ Reset</button>
</div>

<!-- ACTIVE FILTER CHIPS -->
<div class="active-filters" id="activeFilters"></div>

<!-- CONTENT -->
<div class="content">
  <div class="toolbar">
    <div class="result-count"><strong id="toolbarCount">—</strong> results</div>
    <div class="sort-row">
      Sort
      <div class="select-wrap">
        <select class="flt-select" id="sortSelect" onchange="onSort()" style="min-width:160px;font-size:0.72rem;">
          <option value="SKU_asc">SKU A→Z</option>
          <option value="SKU_desc">SKU Z→A</option>
          <option value="Units_desc">Units (High→Low)</option>
          <option value="Units_asc">Units (Low→High)</option>
          <option value="Pack_desc">Pack Date (Newest)</option>
          <option value="Pack_asc">Pack Date (Oldest)</option>
          <option value="Desc_asc">Description A→Z</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="table-wrap">
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th onclick="setSort('SKU')">SKU <span class="sa">↕</span></th>
          <th onclick="setSort('Lot')">Lot Number <span class="sa">↕</span></th>
          <th>Province</th>
          <th onclick="setSort('Desc')">Description <span class="sa">↕</span></th>
          <th>Type</th>
          <th>Status</th>
          <th onclick="setSort('Units')" style="text-align:right">Units <span class="sa">↕</span></th>
          <th style="text-align:right">MC Count</th>
          <th style="text-align:right">THC mg/g</th>
          <th style="text-align:right">CBD mg/g</th>
          <th onclick="setSort('Pack')">Pack Date <span class="sa">↕</span></th>
          <th>Location</th>
        </tr>

RAW.forEach(r => {
  const s = (r.Status || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  r._status = s === 'active' ? 'Active' : s === 'hold' ? 'Hold' : s === 'qa' ? 'QA' : s === 'rtv' ? 'RTV' : s === 'inactive' ? 'Inactive' : r.Status || '';
});

const provinces = [...new Set(RAW.map(r => r['Province/Vendor']).filter(Boolean))].sort();
const types     = [...new Set(RAW.map(r => r['Product Type2']).filter(Boolean))].sort();
const skus      = [...new Set(RAW.map(r => r['MERA SKU']).filter(Boolean))].sort();

// populate dropdowns
function populateSelect(id, values) {
  const sel = document.getElementById(id);
  values.forEach(v => { const o = document.createElement('option'); o.value = v; o.textContent = v; sel.appendChild(o); });
}
populateSelect('selProvince', provinces);
populateSelect('selType', types);
populateSelect('selSKU', skus);

// ── state ──
let filters = { province: '', type: '', status: '', sku: '' };
let search = '', lotSearch = '';
let sortKey = 'SKU', sortDir = 1;
let page = 1, pageSize = 50;
let filtered = [];

// ── dropdown handler ──
function onDropdown(key, el) {
  filters[key] = el.value;
  el.classList.toggle('active', !!el.value);
  page = 1;
  applyFilters();
  renderChips();
}
function onSearch(v)   { search = v.toLowerCase().trim(); page = 1; applyFilters(); renderChips(); }
function onLotInput(v) { lotSearch = v.toLowerCase().trim(); page = 1; applyFilters(); renderChips(); }

function resetAll() {
  ['selProvince','selType','selStatus','selSKU'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.value = '';
    el.classList.remove('active');
  });
  document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('lotInput').value = '';
  filters = { province: '', type: '', status: '', sku: '' };
  search = ''; lotSearch = '';
  page = 1; applyFilters(); renderChips();
}

function renderChips() {
  const container = document.getElementById('activeFilters');
  const chips = [];
  if (filters.province) chips.push({ label: 'Province: ' + filters.province, key: 'province' });
  if (filters.type)     chips.push({ label: 'Type: ' + filters.type, key: 'type' });
  if (filters.status)   chips.push({ label: 'Status: ' + filters.status, key: 'status' });
  if (filters.sku)      chips.push({ label: 'SKU: ' + filters.sku, key: 'sku' });
  if (search)           chips.push({ label: '"' + search + '"', key: 'search' });
  if (lotSearch)        chips.push({ label: 'Lot: ' + lotSearch, key: 'lot' });
  container.innerHTML = chips.map(c =>
    `<span class="filter-chip" onclick="removeChip('${c.key}')">${c.label} <span class="chip-x">✕</span></span>`
  ).join('');
}

function removeChip(key) {
  if (key === 'search') { document.getElementById('searchInput').value = ''; search = ''; }
  else if (key === 'lot') { document.getElementById('lotInput').value = ''; lotSearch = ''; }
  else {
    filters[key] = '';
    const map = { province:'selProvince', type:'selType', status:'selStatus', sku:'selSKU' };
    const el = document.getElementById(map[key]);
    el.value = ''; el.classList.remove('active');
  }
  page = 1; applyFilters(); renderChips();
}

function applyFilters() {
  filtered = RAW.filter(r => {
    if ((+(r['Total Units']) || 0) <= 0) return false;
    if (filters.province && r['Province/Vendor'] !== filters.province) return false;
    if (filters.type     && r['Product Type2']   !== filters.type)     return false;
    if (filters.status   && r._status             !== filters.status)   return false;
    if (filters.sku      && r['MERA SKU']         !== filters.sku)      return false;
    if (lotSearch && !(r['Lot Number']||'').toLowerCase().includes(lotSearch)) return false;
    if (search) {
      const hay = [r['MERA SKU'],r['Lot Number'],r['Product Description'],r['Product Type2'],r['Province/Vendor'],r['Bulk Lot Number']].join(' ').toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(search)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });
  sortData(); updateStats(); renderTable(); renderPagination();
}

const sortMap = {
  SKU:  r => r['MERA SKU'] || '',
  Lot:  r => r['Lot Number'] || '',
  Desc: r => r['Product Description'] || '',
  Units:r => +(r['Total Units']) || 0,
  Pack: r => r['Pack Date'] || '',
};

function sortData() {
  const fn = sortMap[sortKey] || sortMap.SKU;
  filtered.sort((a,b) => { const av=fn(a),bv=fn(b); return av<bv?-sortDir:av>bv?sortDir:0; });
}

function setSort(key) {
  if (sortKey === key) sortDir *= -1; else { sortKey = key; sortDir = 1; }
  document.querySelectorAll('th').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sorted'));
  page = 1; applyFilters();
}

function onSort() {
  const v = document.getElementById('sortSelect').value;
  const [k,d] = v.split('_');
  sortKey = k; sortDir = d === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  page = 1; applyFilters();
}

function updateStats() {
  document.getElementById('statFiltered').textContent  = filtered.length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent     = RAW.length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('toolbarCount').textContent  = filtered.length.toLocaleString();
  const units = filtered.reduce((s,r) => s+(+(r['Total Units'])||0), 0);
  document.getElementById('statUnits').textContent     = units.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('statActive').textContent    = filtered.filter(r => r._status==='Active').length.toLocaleString();
  document.getElementById('statProvinces').textContent = new Set(filtered.map(r=>r['Province/Vendor'])).size;
  document.getElementById('statTypes').textContent     = new Set(filtered.map(r=>r['Product Type2'])).size;
}

function statusBadge(s) {
  const cls = {Active:'active',Inactive:'inactive',Hold:'hold',QA:'qa',RTV:'rtv'}[s]||'inactive';
  return `<span class="badge badge-${cls}">${s}</span>`;
}

function renderTable() {
  const start=(page-1)*pageSize, slice=filtered.slice(start,start+pageSize);
  const tbody=document.getElementById('tableBody'), empty=document.getElementById('emptyState');
  if (!slice.length) { tbody.innerHTML=''; empty.style.display=''; return; }
  empty.style.display='none';
  tbody.innerHTML = slice.map((r,i) => `
    <tr onclick="openModal(${start+i})">
      <td class="sku">${r['MERA SKU']||'—'}</td>
      <td class="lot">${r['Lot Number']||'—'}</td>
      <td><span class="prov-badge">${r['Province/Vendor']||'—'}</span></td>
      <td class="desc" title="${(r['Product Description']||'').replace(/"/g,'&quot;')}">${r['Product Description']||'—'}</td>
      <td class="dim" style="max-width:150px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">${r['Product Type2']||'—'}</td>
      <td>${statusBadge(r._status)}</td>
      <td class="num">${r['Total Units']!==''?Number(r['Total Units']).toLocaleString():'—'}</td>
      <td class="num">${r['MC Count']!==''?r['MC Count']:'—'}</td>
      <td class="thc">${r['Total THC (mg/g)']!==''?r['Total THC (mg/g)']:'—'}</td>
      <td class="cbd">${r['Total CBD (mg/g)']!==''?r['Total CBD (mg/g)']:'—'}</td>
      <td class="dim">${r['Pack Date']||'—'}</td>
      <td class="dim">${r['Location']||'—'}</td>
    </tr>`).join('');
}

function onPageSize() { pageSize=+document.getElementById('pageSizeSelect').value; page=1; renderTable(); renderPagination(); }

function renderPagination() {
  const total=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(filtered.length/pageSize));
  document.getElementById('pageNum').textContent=page;
  document.getElementById('pageTotal').textContent=total;
  let pages=[];
  if(total<=7){for(let i=1;i<=total;i++)pages.push(i);}
  else{
    pages=[1];
    if(page>3)pages.push('…');
    for(let i=Math.max(2,page-1);i<=Math.min(total-1,page+1);i++)pages.push(i);
    if(page<total-2)pages.push('…');
    pages.push(total);
  }
  document.getElementById('pageBtns').innerHTML=
    `<button class="page-btn" onclick="goPage(${page-1})" ${page===1?'disabled':''}>‹</button>`+
    pages.map(p=>p==='…'?`<span style="color:var(--text3);padding:0 4px;font-size:0.8rem">…</span>`
      :`<button class="page-btn ${p===page?'current':''}" onclick="goPage(${p})">${p}</button>`).join('')+
    `<button class="page-btn" onclick="goPage(${page+1})" ${page===total?'disabled':''}>›</button>`;
}

function goPage(p){
  const total=Math.ceil(filtered.length/pageSize);
  if(p<1||p>total)return;
  page=p; renderTable(); renderPagination();
  document.querySelector('.table-wrap').scrollTop=0;
}

function openModal(idx) {
  const r=filtered[idx]; if(!r)return;
  document.getElementById('modalSku').textContent=r['MERA SKU']||'';
  document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent=r['Product Description']||r['MERA SKU'];
  document.getElementById('modalBody').innerHTML=`
    <div class="detail-section">
      <div class="detail-section-title">Identification</div>
      <div class="detail-grid">
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">SKU</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['MERA SKU']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Lot Number</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Lot Number']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Bulk Lot Number</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Bulk Lot Number']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">ERP Item No.</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['ERP Item__No__']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Province / Vendor</div><div class="detail-val">${r['Province/Vendor']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Status</div><div class="detail-val">${statusBadge(r._status)}</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-section">
      <div class="detail-section-title">Product</div>
      <div class="detail-grid">
        <div class="detail-item full"><div class="detail-key">Description</div><div class="detail-val">${r['Product Description']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Product Type</div><div class="detail-val">${r['Product Type2']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">CTLS Category</div><div class="detail-val">${r['CTLS Category']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Unit Size (g)</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Unit Size (g)']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Units / Case</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Units/Case']||'—'}</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-section">
      <div class="detail-section-title">Inventory & Chemistry</div>
      <div class="detail-grid">
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">MC Count</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['MC Count']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Total Units</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Total Units']!==''?Number(r['Total Units']).toLocaleString():'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Net Weight (g)</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Net Weight (g)']!==''?Number(r['Net Weight (g)']).toLocaleString():'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Location</div><div class="detail-val">${r['Location']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Total THC (mg/g)</div><div class="detail-val mono" style="color:var(--accent)">${r['Total THC (mg/g)']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Total CBD (mg/g)</div><div class="detail-val mono" style="color:var(--accent2)">${r['Total CBD (mg/g)']||'—'}</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-section">
      <div class="detail-section-title">Dates</div>
      <div class="detail-grid">
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">Pack Date</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['Pack Date']||'—'}</div></div>
        <div class="detail-item"><div class="detail-key">In Date</div><div class="detail-val mono">${r['In Date']||'—'}</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    ${r['Comments']?`<div class="detail-section"><div class="detail-section-title">Comments</div><div class="detail-grid"><div class="detail-item full"><div class="detail-val" style="color:var(--text2);font-size:0.8rem;line-height:1.5">${r['Comments']}</div></div></div></div>`:''}
  `;
  document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.add('open');
}

function closeModal(e){
  if(e.target===document.getElementById('modalBackdrop'))
    document.getElementById('modalBackdrop').classList.remove('open');
}

document.getElementById('todayDate').textContent=new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA',{year:'numeric',month:'long',day:'numeric'});
applyFilters();
</script>
</body>
</html>
